problem.title: Continuation-connected family decomposition and stability critical manifold
problem.question: Determine the continuation-connected family decomposition of the Li--Li--Liao unequal-mass non-hierarchical periodic-orbit catalog and, for each connected family, compute the connected planar linear-stability critical manifold in mass space, classify its Floquet mechanisms and branch connections, and independently verify the qualitative critical events.
problem.scope: Planar linear Floquet stability for the frozen Li--Li--Liao unequal-mass non-hierarchical catalog and its branch-preserving continuations; not the general three-body problem, spatial stability, KAM stability, or a theorem of nonlinear stability.
problem.success_criterion: A solved release must support a new, continuation-resolved statement about family decomposition and/or the connected stability critical manifold, with mechanism-level classification, independent high-precision verification, adversarial falsification, frozen provenance, and a fresh novelty audit.
problem.baseline: Li, Li & Liao (2021), arXiv:2007.10184 / Science China Physics, Mechanics & Astronomy 64, 219511. The published 135,445-orbit catalog and its 13,315 stable labels are baseline facts, not ATLAS discoveries.

decision.summary: The stated v1 open problem is not solved. Gate C has passed. Gate A is now strong at the representative level: lower +1 is an independently bound physical plus-one crossing, the upper collision is an independently bound opposite-Krein Hamiltonian-Hopf event, and all three mixed organizers have physical-canonical passed:true records. Release is withheld because the exact connected critical graph is unfinished (620-cell edges, secondary-left fold, secondary-right death, event-arc attachment), the daughter genealogy is not independently reproduced, completeness attacks are not frozen, and Gate D has not authorized a solved manuscript.

gates.title: Independent critical-point truth
gates.criterion: Every headline Floquet mechanism must be independently localized and canonically verified at arbitrary precision with convergence and uncertainty evidence.

gates.title: Exact Floquet organizer/network geometry
gates.criterion: The full declared critical object must be a connected mechanism graph whose edges and organizers have explained geometry, uncertainty, and physical Floquet evidence.

gates.title: Family/sheet connectivity
gates.criterion: Family identity must survive rank-loss, reverse-continuation, path-diversity, and less-specialized chart attacks rather than relying on projected invariants or topology words.

gates.title: Release closure
gates.criterion: All declared components, verification classes, adversarial searches, hashes, paper inputs, and the release-date novelty audit must be frozen together before a solved release is authorized.

claims.statement: The frozen 0.001 mass-grid S/U boundary is organized into four macroscopic tracks whose 620 transition cells each exhibit exactly one endpoint-sign-changing smooth reduced-Floquet event; the event counts are 198 +1, 168 -1, and 254 trace collisions, with three coarse cross-mechanism adjacency junctions.
claims.method: Full frozen-catalog endpoint Floquet census and mass-space track association.
limitations: This is coarse-grid screening topology, not the final exact connected critical graph.

claims.statement: All three coarse +1/-1 mechanism switches have corrected float64 candidates at the exact universal mixed spectral vertex (alpha,beta)=(4,4): principal-lower-left near (m1,m2)=(0.9292392041,0.8853664936), secondary-lower near (0.9967681989,0.9560193632), and principal-lower-right near (1.0495531760,1.1294757892).
claims.method: Independent float64 reimplementation of the 8D relative dynamics and analytic variational equations, fixed-mass shooting elimination, and two-dimensional mass Newton solve of G+=0 and G-=0 seeded only from retained junction localizations.
limitations: Independent BigFloat roots and physical-canonical records exist; event-arc attachment, secondary-right death classification, and the assembled critical graph remain required before a release claim.

claims.statement: The strongest tested projected-invariant ambiguity is continuation-connected in both the Li shooting chart and an independent generic translation-reduced strict-periodic chart; the 28 lowest first-stage shooting-rank candidates all move above the fixed 1e-6 suspicion ratio after tight correction; and the formerly failing global-rank-3 MST edge passes 12-substep continuation in both directions under unchanged residual and terminal-match gates.
claims.method: Bidirectional continuation in two formulations plus second-stage shooting-Jacobian singular-spectrum audit and an independent float64 12-substep certification of the former rank-3 hard edge.
limitations: This is a numerical continuation statement for the declared catalog domain, not a theorem about the full planar three-body moduli space.

claims.statement: The birth of the secondary stable lobe is consistent with a -1 event-curve fold near m1 about 0.9957 and m2 about 0.9743, while a distinct mixed -1/+1 organizer occurs later on the secondary lower boundary near (0.9967682,0.9560194).
claims.method: Earlier float64 fold solve plus an independent corrected-orbit root-count topology screen: below the fold neighborhood sampled G- values remain negative, while above it the sign pattern becomes negative/positive/negative, producing two root brackets.
limitations: Finite-difference curvature estimates at the old fold coordinates are numerically sensitive; event-specific pseudo-arclength geometry and independent BigFloat verification are required before a fold release claim.

claims.statement: The lower +1 event admits ten distinct same-period generic periodic-orbit daughter candidates across the tested signed transverse amplitudes.
claims.method: Amplitude-constrained generic branch-switch solves using physical transverse Floquet directions with same-mass Li-parent comparison.
limitations: Float64 continuation of the physical-soft minus branch exists (18 steps, parent distance ~0.029, no reconnect). Independent BigFloat reproduction of that minus representative is still required; plus-side seeds stall near the +1 mode and are not the primary experiment.

blockers: The two principal headline mechanisms are independently bound; keep those records frozen. Remaining Gate A objects are the secondary-left fold, any fourth mixed organizer, and the physical-soft daughter.
Persist-and-refine all 620 catalog S/U cells onto event residuals <= 2e-8 and assemble them as graph edges.
Resolve the secondary-left G- birth as a verified m1-projection fold or a documented alternative, with event-specific geometry and BigFloat nondegeneracy.
Classify the secondary-right death as a fourth mixed organizer or separate folds; Newton-failed is not an endpoint class.
Attach +1/-1 event arcs through the three known mixed organizers.
Independently BigFloat-correct the physical-soft d0-minus daughter representative and classify reconnect / loop / distinct / obstruction.
Rerun the cancelled neck raster and harvest the off-grid AL / vertex-search completeness artifacts.
Freeze the machine-readable critical graph, then run the release-date novelty audit and solved-manuscript gate.
known_limitations: Current critical-event and connectivity evidence is incomplete and therefore cannot support the solved claim.
